task: Fix personal LiteLLM key requests so the user identity (model_kwargs['user'] / injected body 'user' field) is not sent, preventing budget usage from being misattributed to the user instead of bypassed correctly.

Core acceptance criteria are well-defined, but one specific open question needs confirmation before implementation: whether the project-member override that can still inject 'user' during personal-key bypass mode is intentional (per an existing inline comment) or itself part of the defect — the current code comment appears to conflict with a literal reading of the acceptance criteria.

Low novelty overall — the proxy-router path already implements the correct bypass pattern to mirror — but the change affects budget/cost attribution correctness across two parallel implementations, so getting the reconciliation wrong risks silent financial mis-attribution rather than an obvious functional break.
